fact: The INS opened a workshop on 27 November 2025 to validate indicators and tables drawn from the fifth national population and housing census (RGPH-5), whose data were already collected and whose preliminary results were on display; the article gives no enumeration date, so the document's publication date is used.
ADIAC says the fifth general population census was conducted in December 2023.
The World Bank's WDI lists 2007 as the latest population census for Congo.
The World Bank's WDI lists the Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey 2014-2015 as the latest demographic, education or health household survey for Congo.
The World Bank's WDI lists the Core Welfare Indicator Questionnaire Survey/Priority survey, 2011, as the source of the most recent income and expenditure data for Congo.
The World Bank's SPI lists population censuses for Congo in 1996 and 2007 within its scoring window; the latest year is used.
